title: Use existing gcloud/az/aws logins for Vertex, Azure and Bedrock
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Mint provider credentials from an existing CLI login (with consent) instead of asking for keys. Tests zc_cloud_cli_auth_* with fake CLIs.
